*   **When to use:** When fast, high-quality view synthesis is required from a small number of input views, and gradient-based optimization is too slow [S1].

It also mentions that the model 'converges in 4 iterations vs 30,000' (implying the slowness of gradient-based methods) and supports a 'flexible speed-accuracy trade-off'. The evidence confirms the method works with small numbers of input views (e.g., 2-view, 8-view, 16-view) and achieves high quality (outperforming other methods in PSNR). Therefore, the claim that it is suitable for fast, high-quality view synthesis from small input views when gradient-based optimization is too slow is fully supported by the text.
